name: DotIndicator
description: Animated row or column of dots showing the active index of a carousel, stepper or pager.

fields.active: DotStyle? - the dot at the active index
fields.spacing: double? - gap between dots; null = 8 * scaling
fields.padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - padding around the run; null = density base gap

notes: `DotItem`, `ActiveDotItem` and `InactiveDotItem` are deleted: the only animated dot widget had zero readers and the two public classes re-declared the same five parameters.
Defaults are token-derived (`primary` active, `muted` inactive); the old hard-coded 0xFF171717 / 0xFFF5F5F5 literals are gone.
`DotIndicatorDefaults` exposes the default rows for callers that paint their own dots.
